name: Tank Level and Inlet Flow Bidirectional Pump Coupling
description: SWaT tank LIT101 and inlet flow FIT101 are bidirectionally coupled through PLC pump switching: low level activates pump (high flow), high level deactivates pump (low flow). Identity-bidir UPR.
